run_labgraph_module: run a labgraph module by its fully-qualified classname using the entry CLI with --module and --process-name
run_module_with_config_and_state: run a labgraph module restored from pickled config and state files via --config-file-path and --state-file-path
run_module_with_process_manager: run a labgraph module with process manager bootstrap info using --process-manager-state-file and --streams-file-path
run_module_with_runner_options: run a labgraph module with custom runner options loaded from a pickled options file via --options-file-path
load_class_from_path: load a Python class dynamically from a fully-qualified class path string using _load_cls
